module: D09-13 Industry Structure／Porter Five Forces產業結構與波特五力
purpose: Add a third structurally different Taiwan industry control and test whether broad theme labels survive product/application/material decomposition.

sourcePanel.evidence: Taiwan PCB industry-chain domestic+overseas output value NT$1.38tn in 2025; PCB manufacturing output NT$915.2bn.
2025 Q3 product/application divergence and critical-material bottlenecks.
2025 high-speed CCL and substrate-material concentration; Ajinomoto 97.1% of ABF substrate-material market cited by TPCA.
Issuer spans conventional PCB, HDI, rigid-flex, ABF substrate and PP substrate across Taiwan/China production sites.
Issuer positions itself in high-end IC substrates; used only as bounded product-scope evidence.

requiredSubmarkets: upstream CCL / glass cloth / copper foil / specialty materials
marketDefinition.rule: Broad PCB/theme membership is context only. Market-share, rivalry and pricing-power inference require compatible product/application/material denominators.

evidence: 2025 Q3 product categories moved in opposite directions.
AI/server demand favored multilayer/HDI/substrates while flex/rigid-flex weakened.
One issuer such as Nan Ya PCB spans several product markets, so issuer identity is not a one-theme mapping.
High-end HDI, high-layer-count multilayer boards and IC substrates require different process precision, materials and customer qualification.
General PCB capacity cannot be treated as immediately substitutable with advanced substrate/AI-server capacity.

substitutes.evidence: Product substitution occurs within end-application and packaging/design choices; exact cross-elasticities are not frozen.

evidence: TPCA reports structural shortages in low-CTE glass cloth and HVLP copper foil for advanced AI-server platforms.
TPCA reports Ajinomoto at 97.1% of the 2025 ABF substrate-material market, a strong upstream concentration witness.

buyerPower.evidence: AI/server, communications, automotive and consumer applications diverged; issuer-level customer concentration and contract terms are not common-support in this receipt.

crossIndustryFalsification: A broad growth industry can contain shrinking product categories at the same time.
Theme strength in AI servers cannot be assigned to flex/rigid-flex or automotive PCB without product/application exposure evidence.
Upstream material concentration can create supplier power even when downstream PCB manufacturing is fragmented.
An issuer with multiple PCB/substrate products cannot be assigned one static economic exposure without revenue/product mix.
ABF film/material dominance is not the same market as ABF substrate manufacturing or general PCB.

forbidden: Taiwan total PCB output -> issuer market share without compatible issuer product/geography denominator
ABF material share -> ABF substrate manufacturer share
AI-server theme growth -> all PCB issuer benefit
broad PCB manufacturing output -> product-level pricing power
denominatorFirewall.missingRule: Exposure magnitude remains UNKNOWN without compatible disclosed denominator.

pitSemantics.firstEligibleDecision: No earlier than each TPCA/issuer source publication or capture.
pitSemantics.revisionRule: Append industry/product/application vintages; never overwrite prior forecast/actual states.

reasonNoL4: Three-industry generalization is stronger, but there is still no prospective/OOS test of industry-structure states versus future company outcomes, stock-selection value, cost, redundancy or market regimes.
exactNext: BR-057 freeze an effective-dated product/application exposure denominator for selected PCB/ABF issuers before issuer-level structure comparison.
Add buyer/customer concentration only from issuer-native compatible disclosures; otherwise retain UNKNOWN.
No cross-industry Five-Forces composite score before prospective/OOS and redundancy validation.
